items.title: Industrial Chemical Cleaning
items.description: We provide pre-commissioning and maintenance chemical cleaning for HRSG systems, steam boilers, tanks and piping at energy and process facilities. Cooling towers, heat exchangers and condensers are cleaned according to materials and deposit types. With our own equipment and circulation pumps, we deliver project-specific work from technical preparation to final checks in accordance with approved procedures.
bullets: Technical assessment and planning: Selecting the cleaning method based on the equipment, material composition and deposit type.
Project-specific execution: On-site cleaning with our own equipment and circulation systems in accordance with approved procedures.
Process monitoring and control: Monitoring operating parameters and controlling the cleaning process through chemical analyses.
Rinsing and passivation: Performing post-cleaning procedures according to project requirements.
items.resultLabel: From technical preparation to field execution, an approach tailored to your system.

items.title: Water Pretreatment Units
items.description: We undertake the installation of water softening, reverse osmosis and filtration units to meet the process and operating water quality requirements of industrial facilities. We plan system selection and installation according to water demand, feedwater characteristics and operating conditions, and provide maintenance, refurbishment and performance improvement services for existing water softening units.
bullets: Technical assessment and system selection: Identifying units and equipment suited to the facility's water demand and feedwater characteristics.
Unit installation: Installing water softening, reverse osmosis and filtration systems according to project requirements and site conditions.
Maintenance and refurbishment: Resin replacement, control valve maintenance and equipment inspections for existing water softening units.
Performance improvement: Assessing water softening system operating conditions and planning upgrades that support operational continuity.
items.resultLabel: System selection tailored to your facility, planned installation and ongoing operational support for water softening units.

items.imageAlt: Water conditioning illustration combining a water droplet, molecular shapes and industrial cooling systems
items.title: Water Treatment Chemicals
items.description: We supply water treatment chemicals for cooling towers and steam boilers tailored to each facility's water quality and operating conditions. Through water analysis, product selection and dosage monitoring, we support equipment protection, heat transfer efficiency and operational continuity.
bullets: Water analysis and technical assessment: Evaluating water quality and system operating conditions.
Cooling tower chemical program: Selecting products and planning applications to control scale, corrosion and biological growth.
Steam boiler chemical program: Selecting water treatment products to control scale and corrosion.
Dosage and performance monitoring: Evaluating and adjusting the chemical program based on analysis results and application conditions.
items.resultLabel: From water analysis to application monitoring, chemical treatment support tailored to your facility.

items.imageAlt: Industrial chemical cleaning illustration comparing fouled and clean heat exchanger tubes
items.title: Industrial Chemical Cleaning Products
items.description: We supply chemicals for cleaning steam boilers, heat exchangers, condensers, cooling towers, tanks and process pipelines. For scale and mineral deposit removal, rust and oxide removal, degreasing and passivation, we support chemical selection based on equipment materials and deposit types. We provide chemical products suited to application requirements and technical support to businesses and site contractors performing chemical cleaning and flushing with their own teams.
bullets: Scale and mineral deposit removal: Selecting cleaning chemicals suited to deposit types and equipment materials.
Rust and oxide removal: Supplying products for rust and oxide layers on metal surfaces.
Degreasing and passivation: Selecting products according to cleaning needs and project requirements.
Product supply and technical support: Guidance on product selection and usage conditions for chemical cleaning and flushing applications.

items.imageAlt: Team member working with analysis equipment at an industrial facility
items.imageCaption: Field archive · Analysis and technical monitoring
items.title: Laboratory Analysis Services
items.description: We assess water quality and operating conditions through raw water, boiler water and cooling water analyses. Field analyses support process monitoring during chemical cleaning, while water conditioning results guide product selection and the assessment of application conditions. Findings are presented with technical reporting and recommendations tailored to the facility.
bullets: Analysis of raw, boiler and cooling water.
System performance evaluated with technical data.
Chemical program recommendations based on results.

products.name: Powder Chlorine 56%
products.description:
Powder Chlorine 56% is a granular disinfection product used to maintain hygiene and water quality in pool water. Its fast-dissolving structure delivers rapid action and helps keep bacteria, algae and microorganisms under control.

Usage Note: Dosage should be determined based on pool volume, water temperature, bather load and current free chlorine levels. pH and chlorine measurements are recommended before application. Do not mix directly with other chemicals.
usageAreas: Contains 56% available chlorine.
Granular powder form.
Dissolves quickly and acts within a short time.
Helps keep pool water clean and clear.
Suitable for shock chlorination and routine pool maintenance.
Appropriate for villa, residential complex, hotel and commercial pools.

products.name: Chlorine Tablet 90%
products.description:
Chlorine Tablet 90% is a slow-dissolving chlorine tablet used to provide long-lasting disinfection in pool water. Its controlled dissolution helps maintain a balanced chlorine level throughout the pool.

Usage Note: Chlorine tablets should be applied in a controlled manner according to pool volume and daily chlorine demand. They can be used in skimmers, floating dispensers or suitable dosing systems. Chlorine levels should be monitored regularly and the product should not be placed in direct contact with other chemicals.
usageAreas: Contains 90% available chlorine.
Slow-dissolving tablet form.
Provides long-lasting disinfection.
Effective against bacteria, algae and microorganisms.
Supports stable chlorine levels in pool water.
Can be used in skimmers, floating dispensers or automatic dosing systems.

products.name: pH Reducer Powder
products.description:
pH Reducer Powder is a powdered pool chemical used to lower elevated pH values to the ideal range. Maintaining pH balance helps chlorine work more efficiently and keeps water quality stable.

Usage Note: Measure pool water pH before application. Dosage should be determined based on the current pH value, target pH range and pool volume. Do not mix directly with chlorine or other chemicals.
usageAreas: Helps reduce high pH values.
Regulates the chemical balance of pool water.
Supports the disinfection performance of chlorine.
Helps reduce scaling, cloudiness and sediment formation.
Fast-dissolving powder form for practical application.
Can be applied in a controlled manner after regular water testing.

products.name: Algaecide
products.description:
Algaecide is a maintenance chemical that helps prevent algae, biofilm and green water formation in pool water. It is especially useful during hot weather, intense sunlight and periods of heavy pool use.

Usage Note: Algaecide should be applied at regular intervals based on pool volume, bather load and algae growth risk. For best results, use after confirming that pH and chlorine levels are balanced.
usageAreas: Helps prevent algae and biofilm formation.
Reduces green discoloration in pool water.
Supports water clarity.
Helps reduce slippery film on pool walls and floors.
Can be used as a complementary product to chlorine treatment.
Suitable for both indoor and outdoor pools.

products.name: Flocculant / Clarifier
products.description:
Flocculant / Clarifier is a pool maintenance product that helps fine suspended dirt and particles combine and settle in pool water. This allows cloudy pool water to regain a clearer, cleaner appearance.

Usage Note: Dosage should be determined based on the level of cloudiness and pool volume. Run the filtration system after application and remove settled sediment with a pool vacuum when necessary.
usageAreas: Helps clarify cloudy pool water.
Brings fine dirt and particles together.
Supports more efficient filtration system operation.
Helps suspended sediment settle.
Preferred after heavy use, rainfall or water balance disruption.
Suitable for residential, hotel, villa and commercial pools.

products.name: Pool Surface Cleaner
products.description:
Pool Surface Cleaner is a specialised cleaning product that helps remove dirt, oil, limescale, rust and metal stains from pool walls, floors, waterlines, tiles, ceramics and equipment surfaces.

Usage Note: Apply an appropriate amount to the surface to be cleaned, allow brief contact time, then scrub with a brush or sponge. Rinse the surface thoroughly with plenty of water after cleaning. Do not mix with other chemicals.
usageAreas: Helps clean dirt and stains on pool surfaces.
Supports removal of limescale and mineral deposits.
Dissolves oil, sunscreen residue and dirt films.
Helps remove rust and metal stains.
Keeps the pool looking hygienic and well maintained.
Suitable for seasonal opening, closing and periodic pool cleaning.

paragraphs: Kelven Water Treatment provides chemical cleaning, water conditioning and technical consulting services to keep industrial water systems running efficiently, safely and for a long service life.

Our scope includes chemical cleaning of steam boilers, condensers, cooling towers, plate heat exchangers, pipelines, chiller systems and other industrial water circuits, as well as protective chemical programs against corrosion, scale and biological growth.
We aim to be more than a product supplier — a solution partner through analysis, application, monitoring and technical support.

Through our boiler chemicals, cooling tower chemicals, industrial system cleaning, water analysis and technical consultancy services, we aim to maximize operational efficiency and extend system lifespan for industrial facilities.
Our experience in international industrial projects, particularly in Turkmenistan, strengthens our technical competence and capacity to deliver services at global standards.
